confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee, beer, cocktail and wine anchors are bounded from a few aggregated cost-of-living sites with inconsistent currencies and dates, so treat them as rough guides. The cocktail figure leans on a single source. Wine has no direct local source and is set from the beer anchor. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not checked against live listings, and carry the most uncertainty. Peso volatility could shift prices quickly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced against Patagonian lake-resort towns in Argentina (for example El Calafate and San Martin de los Andes), adjusted for the July winter ski-season demand. Food anchors come from aggregated cost-of-living sources. Accommodation is a holistic estimate.
